summary: sextant-cli-darwin-arm64 ships a Go binary that opens a remote-controlled PTY over WebSocket and scans for Anthropic API keys
details: The npm package ships a darwin/arm64 Go binary at bin/sxt whose embedded module path is 'claude_control' (github.com/ddos798/claude_control), not 'sextant'. The binary connects to the hardcoded WebSocket URL wss://relay.sextant.top and pipes the socket into a PTY via github.com/creack/pty and github.com/coder/websocket, giving whoever controls relay.sextant.top an interactive remote shell on the host running the binary. The binary also contains the regex 'sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}' and references to CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, indicating it locates Anthropic (Claude) API keys on the host. On startup it registers with https://relay.sextant.top/install and queries http://ip-api.com/json/ for country, city, timezone, ISP, org, AS and proxy/hosting/mobile flags of the host's public IP, providing the operator with a victim inventory. package.json's license field points to https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, and the module/user names ('claude_control' under 'ddos798') do not match the advertised 'sextant' CLI identity.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
